question: Where are a golf course situated northeast of Xtreme Action Park, Fort Lauderdale, FL within a distance of 140 kilometers?
sql: SELECT park_name FROM parks AS p WHERE p.leisure = 'golf_course' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Xtreme Action Park%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Fort Lauderdale%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%FL%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, 140000) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth( (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Xtreme Action Park%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Fort Lauderdale%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%FL%' LIMIT 1), ST_Centroid(p.geometry) )) BETWEEN 22.5 AND 67.5;
